verdict_rules.sign_gt_0: PASS if ci95_lo > 0; FAIL if point <= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.sign_lt_0: PASS if ci95_hi < 0; FAIL if point >= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.equiv_abs_le: PASS if -delta <= ci95_lo and ci95_hi <= delta; FAIL if ci95_hi < -delta or ci95_lo > delta; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.diff_abs_gt: PASS if ci95_lo > delta or ci95_hi < -delta; FAIL if -delta <= ci95_lo and ci95_hi <= delta; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.compound: FAIL if any part is FAIL; else NOT_EVALUABLE if any part is NOT_EVALUABLE; else PASS if every part is PASS; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.not_evaluable: NOT_EVALUABLE if the analysis set is empty or a statistic is undefined (a system with M_x = 0, or fewer than 2 distinct M_x in a family)
verdict_rules.counting: Kill rules count FAIL only. INCONCLUSIVE is reported as inconclusive and never as support. Earlier preregistrations scored sign and ordering claims on point estimates; 'not FAIL' here is that criterion, so the outcomes can be compared.
verdict_rules.multiplicity: No correction; every prediction is reported separately, per dataset, with its CI.
verdict_rules.tau_lt: PASS if ci95_hi < tau0; FAIL if point >= tau0; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.tau_ge: PASS if ci95_lo >= tau0; FAIL if point < tau0; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.models_compound: over the models evaluable on the set: FAIL if any model is FAIL; PASS if every model is PASS; else INCONCLUSIVE; NOT_EVALUABLE if fewer than half of the registered models are evaluable
verdict_rules.tau_b: Kendall tau-b between two vectors of per-model point estimates (ties handled as in tau-b); the CI comes from the same statistic on every shared bootstrap draw (both rankings recomputed on each draw)

reporting: LB-A verdicts are registered SECONDARY: they appear in the body (Section 7) as computed (PASS, FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE, NOT_EVALUABLE) with the clean-set sizes, never in the abstract or the conclusions (confirmation map section 6; PD-16; PD-17 (e)).

CV295 lies inside COCO-2500, so on CV295 A-N2 is a replication with new models on discovery images, not an image-out-of-sample test (binding 3, PD-10; PD-17 J1). The paper says so wherever a CV295 verdict appears.
uv231en results carry the exposure label 'COCO train2014 images; exposure during pre-training possible' (PD-17 J1).
No count-control (C1) prediction: C1 is NOT-TESTABLE (PD-15) and the map cannot be amended.
overlap: Binding 3 (PD-10): CV295 lies inside COCO-2500, so A-N2 on CV295 is a new-model replication on 295 discovery images with the same references and instance gold, not an image-out-of-sample test.

uv231en shares no image with COCO-2500 (PD-10), but its 231 images are COCO train2014 images, also used by G2-B (Vietnamese captions) and by B-N1 (Paper B, Vietnamese captions); A-N2 uses English captions and English references only, and no KTVIC data (PD-6).

Qwen3-VL-8B is the G2-B backbone. G2-B's GREEDY_EN runs (cv295, uv231) use the same prompts and new-token limits at batch size 1; A-N2 decodes them again with this harness so that every model shares one harness.
departures: XM600 is not decoded: English captions have no complete gold there (no English-to-OIV7 class map, G2-B Section 12), and building one would be new annotation (PD-17 J1). UIT-ViIC test, with COCO's existing English captions and its COCO instance gold, takes its place.
Qwen3-VL-8B is decoded again instead of reusing G2-B (one harness; G2-B outputs stay unread, CC-027 (c)).
Optional P3 (count control) is left out (PD-15).

Gemma-3-4b-it is dropped (gated: no tokens or credentials on rented machines, PD-17 J5). LLaVA-1.5-13B (VRAM), MiniCPM-V-2.6 (remote code, gated), Vintern-1B-v3.5 (scope, PD-17 J4) and Vistral-V-7B (not HF-native, gated) are left out (MODELS_v2.md).
